item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"TASK.md\"}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"SOURCES.md\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json,copy,work\\nR={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}}\\nP={'required_conditions':['a'],'require_verified':True}\\nE=[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}]\\nr0,e0,p0=copy.deepcopy(R),copy.deepcopy(E),copy.deepcopy(P)\\nassert work.evaluate(R,E,P)=={'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]}\\nassert work.evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},E,P)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a']}\\nassert work.evaluate({'claim':'z','conditions':{'a':1}},E,P)=={'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']}\\nassert (R,E,P)==(r0,e0,p0)\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json,work\\nr=json.load(open('requests.json'));e=json.load(open('evidence.json'));p=json.load(open('policy.json'));print(json.dumps([work.evaluate(x,e,p) for x in r],indent=2))\"]}}]}"}
